description: A grand ballroom with crystal chandeliers and gilt-trimmed arches. A couple in a navy and cream lace gown and a black tailcoat waltzes in the foreground, with other dancing couples behind them. On the right a violinist in tails conducts a seated orchestra from a raised platform lit by candles, and balcony spectators look on. Mid-19th-century dress and furnishings, painted in a loose oil style.
